about_short_description.short_description: Esusu is the nation’s leading financial technology platform advancing credit building and economic mobility.

product.name: Esusu Rent Reporting
product.description: Reports renters’ on-time rental payments to Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion to help establish or improve credit histories.

product.name: Esusu Credit Hub
product.description: A credit-monitoring experience that provides score insights, change alerts, credit-report monitoring, and report access for renters.

product.name: Esusu Pay
product.description: A flexible rent-payment service that lets eligible residents split rent into two payments while properties receive the full rent amount upfront.

product.name: Esusu Rent Relief
product.description: A rent-assistance program that helps eligible renters address temporary financial hardship, past-due rent, and eviction risk.

product.name: Esusu Financial Coaching
product.description: Provides residents with confidential one-to-one financial coaching and workshops covering credit, debt, budgeting, saving, and home-buying preparation.

product.name: Esusu Identity Services
product.description: Provides identity, income, and Social Security number verification tools for housing-related onboarding, fraud prevention, and eligibility checks.
